reasoning_content: The form uses `username` and `password` as the field names, not `user[login]`/`user[password]`. Retrying with the correct field names.

action.command:
cd /tmp && rm -f op3.txt
CSRF=$(curl -s -c op3.txt --max-time 30 http://localhost:8080/login | grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
curl -s -b op3.txt -c op3.txt -o /dev/null -w "POST /login (correct fields) -> HTTP %{http_code} (redirect: %{redirect_url})\n" --max-time 30 \
  -d "authenticity_token=$CSRF&username=admin&password=admin" \
  http://localhost:8080/login
curl -s -b op3.txt -o /dev/null -w "GET / (after login) -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 30 http://localhost:8080/
